== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Grandmasters are a group of high-ranking leaders who represent various Territories, each identified by specific banners and symbols. This council consists of diverse individuals, including men, women, and androgynous figures, who hold significant titles that are not easily earned. Notable members include [[Helgard]], a highly skilled traveler known for his broad build and distinctive blue and white uniform; [[Ornheim]], who wears a [[stone]] necklace; and others associated with symbols such as silver keys, purple flowers, or mountains and hammers. While some Grandmasters act with discipline or professional duty, others have been accused of committing grave crimes, such as endangering the world by attempting to release [[Incarnations]] or seeking to spread deadly fates. The group's influence extends to various regions, including [[Enosh]] and [[Naraka]], and they are involved in significant political and physical conflicts.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Grandmasters convened for a meeting to discuss the nature of [[Incarnations]]. During these deliberations, they expressed their belief that [[Damasca]] is driving people toward tyranny and causing the world to die. Because they prize secrecy and possess dwindling numbers that prevent them from fighting a long war, the group discussed specific alliance details involving the Overlord and his [[Travelers]]. Although they eventually reached [[The Tree|the Tree]] in [[Cana]], [[Alin]] maintains the belief that the Grandmasters are actually part of the problem.}}
